name: 5e Serpraise
oneLiner: Corporate training and organizational development platform built across two major generational releases.
briefDescription: A human resources, corporate training, and organization development initiative operating since 2003 across India and Australia. We architected and delivered both generations of their digital experience: Version 1 on production and Version 2 with a modernized, editorial design system and interactive module architecture.

name: Manraah
oneLiner: A mental wellness platform with dedicated student, professional, and admin experiences.
briefDescription: A mental wellness platform with entirely separate experiences for students, professionals, and admins — each with its own permissions, flows, and interface, not one dashboard trying to serve three audiences at once.

name: Coppter
oneLiner: A workforce management system with four dedicated portals for different job roles.
briefDescription: A workforce intelligence platform built around four distinct roles — a leadership dashboard for strategic analytics, HR operations tools, personalized growth assessments for employees, and a mentor-facing view for career guidance. Four different logins, because four different people need four different tools, not one dashboard wearing four hats.

name: NutriFlex
oneLiner: Your personal AI fitness assistant delivering dynamic workout plans and weekly health tasks.
briefDescription: An intelligent fitness and nutrition platform built to eliminate generic routines. NutriFlex generates customized weekly workout schedules, dynamic exercise progressions, and AI-driven motivational encouragement tailored to individual goals.

name: CourseHunt
oneLiner: A course discovery platform that helps students find the right learning opportunities.
briefDescription: A fast course aggregator built on Next.js and Supabase. Students were losing hours hunting for course links scattered across the internet — CourseHunt automates discovery and validation so listings are already there, and already working, when they arrive.

name: TradeSage
oneLiner: An AI-powered trading platform that analyzes market patterns and executes data-driven trades.
briefDescription: An algorithmic trading system for the Indian equity market. We trained a model on ten years of NSE data across 2,200+ stocks, then wrapped it in automated risk controls — position sizing, regime filters, and a daily loss kill-switch — so the model can't outrun its own discipline.
